title: Chinese Journal of UFO Research tacitly endorsed by CCP
summary: David Grusch tells of Chinese Journal of UFO Research tacitly endorsed by CCP, about late 1990s- at People's Republic of China, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The Chinese have what they call the journal of UFO Research, which is a published periodical in the People's Republic of China.

plain: David Grusch, interviewed by podcast host Jesse Michels, says China has a regular published magazine called the Journal of UFO Research. According to the story, from the late 1990s on it came out with the quiet approval of the Chinese Communist Party, the party that rules the country. If true, it would suggest China's leaders allowed open study of UFOs at a time when other governments kept quiet about it.
